name: Remote viewing stock market trading programs

mentions.name: Remote viewing stock market trading programs
mentions.description: This project experiments with remote viewing as a method for trading the stock market, run in two versions: an analog version where a collaborator shows a colored board depending on the week's outcome, and a solo version implemented as a Swift app on Mac. Both have just exited a buggy beta and will be compared to see which one works and wins.
mentions.source_excerpt: * Remote viewing stock market trading programs - One version is with a buddy who shows me a colored board depending on the outcome for the week.  The other is a solo version using a Swift app on Mac.  We're just out of buggy beta (the analog version was laughably more difficult to get clean.  We'll see if either works and which one wins.
